save_img: save a 3-channel image tensor to a file path as a PNG image
save_vid: save a video tensor to an H.264 MP4 file with configurable FPS and CRF
save_video_audio_to_mp4: save video and audio tensors into a single MP4 file with FFmpeg
get_fps: retrieve the FPS and frame count from a video file path
review_save_img: review the save_img function that saves a 3-channel image tensor to disk
